title: California Condors Rose From 27 To 500
hook: California condors rose from 27 birds to 500.
closing: The population survived, but lead poisoning still threatens every hard-won generation.
question: Have you ever seen a condor?

segments.say: California condors fell to 27 birds, leaving the species one disaster from extinction.
The population reached 500, reversing a collapse once thought nearly impossible to stop.
Lead poisoning causes 50% of known deaths, keeping the species dependent on continued protection.
